author: Jannis_V
name: gpx_export
description: Generates a GPX track file from all images that contain GPS latitude and longitude information, creating a separate track per source folder.
description-extensive: This tool collects the GPS locations stored in your geotagged photos and writes them into a GPX track file. Each folder of images becomes its own track, so you can view or share the route your photos followed on a map. No extra software is needed.
